## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.97%) and LQD (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +0.11%) show HYG/LQD credit stress ↓ (CORRECTION) and Stocks vs Bonds SPY/TLT (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +4.72%) is ↓ falling (CORRECTION), while VXX (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND is complacent—mixed fear signal.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress increasing: HYG/LQD balanced toward stress with HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.97%) and LQD (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +0.11%) in CORRECTION. Safe-haven demand and gold strength: GLD (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND and VIX/VXX complacency VXX (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND show risk-off with pockets of speculative chase (IBIT/ARKK).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar weakening and yields mixed: UUP (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND while TLT (1W: +0.01% | 1M: -0.95%) RECOVERY; overall SPY/TLT (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +4.72%) CORRECTION signals stocks losing short-term preference vs bonds.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Healthcare leading: XLE (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND and Healthcare sector ETF proxy XBI (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +8.87%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging with XLK (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +2.72%) in CORRECTION and Financials XLF (1W: -2.01% | 1M: +2.73%) in CORRECTION — style: Value/Cyclicals showing relative strength vs Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US softening: SPY (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +3.73%) CORRECTION while Emerging Markets and China outpace: EEM (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; Europe showing mixed recovery (FEZ 1W: -0.47% | 1M: +6.80% CORRECTION).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation elevated: IBIT (1W: +22.59% | 1M: +19.18%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +6.30% | 1M: +16.77%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: -1.68% | 1M: +2.69%) CORRECTION—risk-on flows concentrated in crypto/thematic, not broad market.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: GLD (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND; industrial signals mixed with CPER (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.58%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strength intact: XLE (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +6.24% | 1M: +0.65%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY shows divergent fuel dynamics.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Gold/precious metals GLD (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND; Energy XLE ABOVE TREND confirmed. Major divergence: core risk ETFs show 1W vs 1M mismatches across SPY, XLK, XLF and TLT → MAJOR DIVERGENCE, so treat regime signals with caution.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and precious metals ETFs (XLE, GLD) as showing strength and reduce exposure to rate-sensitive growth tech (XLK, QQQ) given short-term weakness; monitor credit via HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.97%) CORRECTION and VXX (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND for shifts in fear.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +7.17%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +8.87%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +2.72%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND if risk-off deepens.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +5.45% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND on safe-haven demand. BEARISH: UNG (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY if cooling seasonal demand persists.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.97% / LQD 1W: -0.19% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION — watch credit spread re-widening. SPY (1W: -1.37% | 1M: +3.73%) CORRECTION — monitor failure to reclaim recent support.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive with credit stress (HYG/LQD) and SPY/TLT weakness providing primary confirmations. Energy (XLE) and precious metals (GLD, SLV) showing relative strength while Tech (XLK) and broad growth display a major divergence to monitor.
